facts.fact: The Mauritius Judiciary's notices say attorneys at the Commercial Division must file written submissions online through the e-filing system and apply online for subpoenas, new features introduced from 11 January 2021.

The Mauritius Judiciary says registered online users of the e-Judiciary system can top up their account, used for court filing fees, by credit card (module implemented 28 February 2022) and by MauCAS QR code or account transfer (from 23 October 2023).
